entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes. It's VF88602-P.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. Is that correct?
Sounds right.
Okay. And what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just not for me. I already tried to return it last week, and your site was broken.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to process the return?
I went to the returns page, and it just gave me a website error. I figured the whole system was down because I couldn't print the label or anything. I even took a screenshot of it.

I understand your frustration, and thank you for that detail. Let me check our system logs... Yes, I do see a record of a known outage on our returns portal around that time. My sincerest apologies for that inconvenience.
Whatever.
Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. I see the delivery was 17 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy. I can absolutely get this processed for you right away.
Fine.

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. And for the trouble you experienced with our site, and as a thank you for being a VIP customer, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase.
Great. It's about time something worked.
I understand. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
